asserts.baseline: Terraform; OpenTofu is expressed as the delta from it
asserts.portability: the stack must also parse on the Terraform baseline

name: dialect-opentofu
never_do: run Terraform, OpenTofu, or any other tool
access Terraform state, cloud APIs, or cloud credentials
produce apply, import, state, or destroy commands
quote a provider version or an argument delta - those are in facts.json for the pins this job uses
state an account id, a real environment name or a CIDR that was not supplied as an input
add infrastructure to close a policy finding

provenance.source_reference: infra/hermes-engine/skills/codegen-opentofu-{aws,azure,gcp}/SKILL.md, which are byte-similar and differ only in the provider address each names. docs/hermes-engine/SKILLS-AUDIT.md §1 in the iacgenius-vercel repository traces every line of that file to the TypeScript prompt it was ported from. Harvested through the evidence-card adapters (ADR-016); every version pin and delta table the source carried was refused by the scrub and moved to facts/.

purpose: The OpenTofu delta from the Terraform baseline: portability, CLI naming, provider source addresses. Five things, and no cloud knowledge at all.
